name: Bone Rap
description: Knock hard with a forearm packed with bone qi so the blow lands like a wooden club.

name: Frame Brace
description: Lock the ribs and spine into a rigid frame to take a heavy blow without folding.

name: Shin Glide
description: Push off a braced shin and glide a long step sideways with the frame held straight.

name: Density Draw
description: Draw qi into the bones of the user until each blow lands with a denser and heavier frame.

name: Frame Sense
description: Feel through the soles and palms for the framework of whatever is touched and find its weak joint.

name: Rib Thrust
description: Push a rib-shaped lance of bone out of the side and thrust it into the target's chest.

name: Rib Dart
description: Snap a short rib dart off the lance and throw it at a foe within a few paces.

name: Rib Parry
description: Turn a cut aside on the curved bone of the lance and slide it past the ribs.

name: Rib Draw
description: Draw the lance slowly out of the ribs and let the bone harden along its length.

name: Rib Count
description: Tap the lance on a body and count the ribs by the ring to learn how it is built.

name: Spur Jab
description: Jab the sharp end of the lance short and fast at the target's guard arm.

name: Hinge Twist
description: Twist a foe's wrist or elbow against its hinge so the arm loses its grip and its aim.

name: Elbow Snap
description: Whip the elbow across on a locked joint and crack the point into the target's jaw.

name: Knee Hook
description: Hook the back of the target's knee with a bent shin and fold the leg under them.

name: Pivot Step
description: Turn on one hip joint with qi packed in the socket and step clear of the line of attack.

name: Joint Brace
description: Set every joint of the arm in a locked line so a wrenching grip cannot bend it.

name: Hinge Sense
description: Grip a limb and feel how far each joint will turn before it gives.

name: Splint Mend
description: Lay a splint of bone qi along an ally's broken limb to hold it still and ease the pain.

name: Knit Bone
description: Draw the two ends of a break together with qi and knit them so the ally's bone grows whole.

name: Set True
description: Pull a crooked break back into line with a quick firm movement and fix it in place.

name: Fracture Read
description: Press the qi into an injured limb and read where the bone is broken and how badly.

name: Callus Build
description: Coax a hard callus of new bone round a mending break so it can bear weight sooner.

name: Cradle Hold
description: Wrap bone qi round a wounded ally in a rigid cradle that takes blows that would break them again.

name: Seam Check
description: Run a thumb along a mended bone and feel for any seam that has not yet closed.

name: Marrow Breath
description: Breathe slowly into the long bones until the marrow warms and the limbs fill with strength.

name: Marrow Strike
description: Throw a fist or kick from the marrow outward so the whole bone rings through the blow.

name: Deep Draw
description: Pull a full draught of qi into the thigh bones to steady the legs for the next exchange.

name: Light Spring
description: Lighten the long bones with hollow qi and take a quick springing step away.

name: Marrow Ward
description: Pack the marrow tight so a blow to the limb is dulled before it reaches the core of the bone.

name: Knuckle Spur
description: Raise short spurs of bone at the knuckles and punch so they bite into the target.

name: Spur Hook
description: Catch the target's sleeve or guard on a spur and drag the arm out of line.

name: Spur Guard
description: Meet a weapon on the spurs of the forearm and slide it off the bony ridge.

name: Fist Packing
description: Pack bone qi into the small bones of the hand until the fist is as dense as a mallet.

name: Spur Probe
description: Tap with a single spur to hear whether wood or bone or hollow lies beneath a surface.

name: Cutting Spur
description: Draw the spur across the target's arm in a short slash that opens the skin.
